meta.title: Why A Car Lease Is Priced Nothing Like A Car Loan
meta.hook: A low lease payment can hide the most important number in the deal: what the car is expected to lose in value.
meta.description: A car loan finances the full purchase price of the vehicle. A lease works differently: it charges you for the vehicle's expected depreciation over the lease term, plus a finance charge, because the car goes back to the dealer at the end. That's why a lease payment is usually lower than a loan payment on the same car, but you own nothing when it's over. Educational content only, not financial advice.
